title: Tests are sensors and unjustified weakening fails the hard gate
statement: Every test MUST reference the invariant or invariants it probes, a test MUST NOT be modified to make failing code pass, and a commit touching F3 whose AST-diff weakening exceeds the configured thresholds without a tracked invariant change MUST produce a hard-gate FAIL while weakening within thresholds without a tracked change MUST produce REVIEW.
rationale: Articles 29 and 30 keep the observation substrate honest: a sensor that is tuned to the plant measures nothing.

strategy.rationale: A deterministic test corpus under tests/ and packages/*/tests observes this obligation; trace links the tests.
